root.label: Trump calls for Roger Clemens Hall of Fame induction

events.label: Trump calls for Roger Clemens Hall of Fame induction

slots.name: induction call count
slots.sentence: Trump called on the Baseball Hall of Fame Committee in December to induct Clemens, blaming former President Obama’s Justice Department for what he described as using “rumors and innuendo” surrounding the alleged doping to inform its investigation.

slots.name: career games won
slots.sentence: “Roger Clemens is the only pitcher who has won 300 games to not have the honor of being enshrined in the Hall of Fame, which is a total travesty!” Trump wrote in a Truth Social post at the time.

slots.name: legal outcome status
slots.sentence: “He never tested positive and, when the Obama DOJ went after him in a criminal case claiming that he did take steroids, Roger, who has always denied taking any drugs, was FULLY ACQUITTED OF ALL CHARGES.”
